'''Skav Mora''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He asked an Imperial to deal a blow to organ thievery going on in Hutt Territory.
